scientific_integrity: A complete all-parameter proof is supplied; finite enumeration checks selected parameters but is not a proof of infinite cases. The statements explicitly credit previous scalar product and local visibility criteria.
scientific_limitations: The tree must have at least three vertices and the second factor must be connected and nontrivial. The sphere-wedge formula concerns the particular rook-prism second factor. Novelty is provisional, not independently verified.
title: Tree-leaf joins and sphere-wedge total mutual-visibility complexes of rook prisms
